request.style: English, energetic modern worship, bright female worship-leader vocal with choir, electric guitars, synth pads, driving drums, bass, rising and celebratory, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They were all together in one place when Pentecost had come
Waiting for the promise as the Lord had told them, every one
Then a sound came from heaven like a rushing, violent wind
And tongues as of fire came down and rested on each of them

[Chorus]
I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh
Your sons and your daughters will prophesy
Your young men will see visions
And your old men will dream dreams

[Verse]
From every nation under heaven came a crowd to hear the sound
Each one heard them in his own language, and amazement spread around
Some mocked them, full of new wine, but Peter stood up with the eleven
And raised his voice to tell them of the promise sent from heaven

[Pre-Chorus]
This is what was spoken through the prophet Joel

[Chorus]
I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh
Your sons and your daughters will prophesy
Your young men will see visions
And your old men will dream dreams

[Bridge]
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord
Will be saved
Come, Holy Spirit, like wind and fire

[Chorus]
I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh
Your sons and your daughters will prophesy
Your young men will see visions
And your old men will dream dreams

[Outro]
I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh
